the probability of experiencing MSP combinations is different between boys and girls and between younger and older children/adolescent, and the likelihood of having pain at three and/or four locations is lower in boys than in other gender and age groups.

the identification of the most vulnerable subgroups in terms of MSP combinations, and the results can provide the basis for developing more targeted interventions.

the MSP combinations in school children/adolescent is not only a gender–age specific but also a gender–age dependent issue.
